# Recap: The Daily Journal App

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## Recap: The Daily Journal App

Let's recap what happened in the React Hooks course. Over its four chapters we built a Daily Journal App from scratch.

![Journal App](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Here's what we did:

- Pulled real data from an API with useEffect()
- Built an entry drawer that detects outside clicks with useRef()
- Added search and pagination with useMemo()
- Extracted all of that logic into custom hooks so the component code stayed clean

At the end of that course, our app ended up with the following features:

- One page
- One URL
- All the logic lives in App.jsx or a handful of hooks

It works. It performs well. But it isn't quite a real-world app yet.
